candidateControl: Allow authority references to carry a commit/blob revision or snapshot path, and warn when a changed authority section is still bound by other packets.

chainJoins.earliestControlPoint: pre-commit check when a registered authority section changes
chainJoins.gap: no revision pin or snapshot reference; closed unchanged packets are not re-checked by phase gates
chainJoins.join: authority section edit -> closed packet bound to it

claimLimits: One project, one closed packet; local snapshot repair validated directly; no parent acceptance or hosted CI claim.
expected: A closed packet remains verifiable against the criteria revision it was dispatched with, without rewriting its coverage block.
observed: Direct coverage validation of a closed work order returned COV_AUTHORITY_STALE after the bound roadmap section was edited post-closure; the registry allows one path per milestone ID and the validator reads only the current file.
title: Closed work order coverage authority goes stale when the live roadmap section is edited
